lines: Ghazab kiya tere waade pe aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: What folly it was to trust your promise.

lines: Tamaam raat qayaamat ka intizaar kiya

lines: Ghazab kiya tere waade pe aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: What folly it was to trust your promise.

lines: Hansa hansa ke shab-e-wasl ashkbaar kiya
couplets.en: You made me laugh until I wept on the night we met.

lines: Tasalliyaan mujhe de de ke beqaraar kiya
couplets.en: Each word of comfort left me more restless.

lines: Ghazab kiya tere waade pe aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: What folly it was to trust your promise.

lines: Hum aise mahv-e-nazaara na the jo hosh aata
couplets.en: I was too lost in looking at you to come to my senses.

lines: Magar tumhaare taghaaful ne hoshyaar kiya
couplets.en: Your indifference brought me back to myself.

lines: Ghazab kiya tere waade pe aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: What folly it was to trust your promise.

lines: Fasaana-e-shab-e-gham unko ik kahaani thi
couplets.en: My night of sorrow was a tale to them.

lines: Kuchh aitbaar kiya kuchh na aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: Some of it they believed, and some they doubted.

lines: Ghazab kiya tere waade pe aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: What folly it was to trust your promise.

lines: Ye na thi hamaari qismat ke visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Agar aur jeete rehte yahi intizaar hota
couplets.en: Had I lived longer, I would have gone on waiting.

lines: Ye na thi hamaari qismat
couplets.en: It was never written in my fate.

lines: Tere waade par jiye hum to ye jaan jhoot jaana
couplets.en: If you think your promise kept me alive, think again.

lines: Ke khushi se mar na jaate agar aitbaar hota
couplets.en: Had I believed you, I would have died of joy.

lines: Ye na thi hamaari qismat
couplets.en: It was never written in my fate.

lines: Koi mere dil se poochhe tere teer-e-neem-kash ko
couplets.en: Ask my heart what it knows of your half-drawn arrow.

lines: Ye khalish kahaan se hoti jo jigar ke paar hota
couplets.en: Would it still ache if the arrow had passed clean through?

lines: Ye na thi hamaari qismat
couplets.en: It was never written in my fate.

lines: Ye masaael-e-tasavvuf ye tera bayaan Ghalib
couplets.en: How you speak of the mysteries of the spirit, Ghalib.

lines: Tujhe hum wali samajhte jo na baada-khwaar hota
couplets.en: I would take you for a saint were you any less fond of wine.

lines: Agar aur jeete rehte yahi intizaar hota

lines: Meri mohabbat qubool kar lo
couplets.en: Will you accept my love?

lines: Ghareeb shaayar ke aansuon ka haqeer tohfa qubool kar lo
couplets.en: Accept the poor poet's tears, the little he has to give.

lines: Meri mohabbat mein saadgi hai
couplets.en: My love is simple.

lines: Meri mohabbat mein aajizi hai
couplets.en: My love comes to you humbly.

lines: Meri mohabbat mein shaayari hai
couplets.en: There is poetry in my love.

lines: Ye shaayari bhi to aap ki hai
couplets.en: Even these verses belong to you.

lines: Meri mohabbat qubool kar lo
couplets.en: Will you accept my love?

lines: Meri mohabbat hai chaand jaisi
couplets.en: My love is like the moon.

lines: Jo shab mein kirnein luta raha ho
couplets.en: It scatters its light through the night.

lines: Meri mohabbat hai phool jaisi
couplets.en: My love is like a flower.

lines: Jo har ghadi muskura raha ho
couplets.en: It smiles at every hour.

lines: Meri mohabbat
couplets.en: My love.

lines: Mujhe to kuchh iska gham nahin hai
couplets.en: I do not grieve over it.

lines: Ke meri duniya mein gham hi gham hai
couplets.en: My world is already full of sorrow.

lines: Meri mohabbat chakor jaisi
couplets.en: My love is like the partridge that yearns for the moon.

lines: Ke jis pe jitna ho naaz kam hai
couplets.en: However much I cherish it, it is never enough.

couplets.en: Will you accept my love?

lines: Poochh na mujhse dil ke fasaane

lines: Masti aankhein choom rahi thi
couplets.en: Delight brushed our eyes like a kiss.

lines: Saari duniya jhoom rahi thi
couplets.en: The whole world seemed to sway.

lines: Do dil the woh bhi deewaane

lines: Aayi khizaan rangeen chaman mein
couplets.en: Autumn came to the garden in all its color.

lines: Aag lagi jab dil ke ban mein
couplets.en: Fire took hold in the woodland of the heart.

lines: Aaya na koi aag bujhaane
couplets.en: No one came to put out the fire.

lines: Kitne shireen hain tere lab ke raqeeb

lines: Kya woh Namrood ki khudaai thi

lines: Kuchh to padhiye ke log kehte hain
couplets.en: Recite something, for people are beginning to talk.

lines: Shauq har rang raqeeb-e-sar-o-saamaan nikla
couplets.en: Longing in every guise proved the enemy of worldly comfort.

lines: Qais tasveer ke parde mein bhi uryaan nikla
couplets.en: Even the painted canvas could not clothe Qais.

lines: Zakhm ne daad na di tangi-e-dil ki ya Rab
couplets.en: Lord, even the wound gave my constricted heart no room.

lines: Teer bhi seena-e-bismil se par-afshaan nikla

lines: Boo-e-gul naala-e-dil dood-e-charaagh-e-mehfil

lines: Jo teri bazm se nikla so pareshaan nikla
couplets.en: Whatever left your gathering went out adrift.

lines: Dil mein phir girye ne ik shor uthaaya Ghalib
couplets.en: Once more, Ghalib, weeping stirred an uproar in the heart.

lines: Aah jo qatra na nikla tha so toofaan nikla
couplets.en: The tear that would not fall came out as a flood.
